text:
jess.release: deploybot flagged increased tail latency on /v1/chat in prod-eu at 08:12 UTC. Suggests autorevert to v3.0.2.

deploybot: [ALERT] route=/v1/chat env=prod-eu p99=3.4s threshold=2.0s action=suggest_autorevert note=kv-cache-pressure

omar.oncall: Seeing ~0.25% 5xx and timeouts from a subset of pods. Correlates with a config flip for kernel-opt. Not big blast radius yet.

kat.platform: I'd prefer manual rollback to avoid churn with the canary. Can someone pin v3.0.1?

jess.release: I'll pin and coordinate. Proposed rollback steps: pin -> run rollback job -> monitor p99/p95 for 10m -> update release notes -> notify customers if impacted.

support-triage: Suggested command: `./infra/rollout --env=prod-eu --pool=chat-eu --to=v3.0.1 --drain=60`

kat.platform: Pin applied (req=pf-77). Starting rollback job now.

deploybot: rollback job started id=rb-eu-20260305-07

omar.oncall: Drain done on 6/6 nodes. p99 down to 1.8s, 5xx back to baseline.

jess.release: rollback complete, all traffic on v3.0.1. Action items: create postmortem, add kernel-opt to canary gate, disable auto-autorevert for this rollout window.

support-triage: Opening incident: https://internal/inc/INC-2026-99 and sending customer blurb to support ops.

jess.release: Thanks all. Will follow up with PM ticket and postmortem owner assignment. Thread will close after support confirms customer notifications.
